name: Gasthof Oberstegen
beschreibung: The Gasthof Oberstegen in Söll, Tirol, is a traditional hotel in the town center. The decor is designed in Alpine style. The surroundings offer a mountain landscape with hiking and skiing opportunities. The hotel has a restaurant with regional cuisine. The rooms are furnished with wooden furniture. A wellness area with sauna is available. Guests benefit from the direct proximity to the SkiWelt. Parking is available on-site.
